scene clearnightsky
To what do I owe this pleasure? That of traipsing down a faintly lit path just blocks away from the dorm as if this is where I’m meant to be...
That of spending my night beside a lovable girl — yet a girl that I can not love because I haven’t figured out how to yet.
Maybe it would be easier if she wasn’t so nice to me.
Maybe if she went on long-winded rants about how I’m the most disgusting man on the face of the earth...
Or if she took me on tours of my childhood or...cut her hair in a fit of panicked rage because of my absence-
Maybe then the love would come easier.
I don’t know why I’ve taken it upon myself to disperse my heaviest thoughts and feelings on those shouldering the most weight, but perhaps it has something to do with my affinity for destruction.
scene futabanighttraipse1
Just thirty minutes ago, this same girl was calling me “Daddy.”
She was riding my lap as if she was bred to do that. And while that’s not something I’d encourage other prospective fathers out there to do, I’ll admit that it was quite invigorating.
But now comes the silence — that reflective retrospective and all that rides in on its shoulders, but not out of the affinity to destroy.

It rides in that way because the weight serves to keep us grounded. It makes it feel as if we’re not floating away when all of the bubbles that exist within us as the result of a thing called “bliss” begin to lift us up.
Typically speaking, I’m the one who habitually pops them as I’ve always had a fear of heights.
But on some nights when I’m spent, and I can guarantee you that tonight is one of those nights, I just can’t seem to find my needle.
I could burst them with my finger, I’m sure. But the idea of getting any of that joy all over my hands does nothing but make me want to wash them.
I wonder what we’ll talk about tonight.
I wonder if it will make me like her more, or make me like her less.
I wonder if it even matters.
: Sensei...
Here it comes — that unwanted weight.
: Yeah?
: Tell me more about Ami.
scene futabanighttraipse2
: Huh?
: Are you surprised that’s what I want to talk about?
: Kind of, considering she’s public enemy number one for most people by now.
: Love makes us do all sorts of crazy things. That in mind, I don’t really find anything Ami said all that “crazy.”
: She threatened to dismember you.
: Yes, but do you really think she’d follow through with it?
: Kind of, yeah.
scene futabanighttraipse3
: Oh. Well, maybe my self-defense instinct isn’t all that functional then.
: But still, she’s the biggest change in your life lately. And I’m interested in hearing more about how things are shaping up now that I’m not distracted by...other things.
: You mean how you missed me so much that your body opened itself up to me the moment I showed up in your room?
scene futabanighttraipse4
: Exactly. Though, I’d word it in a much less vulgar way since I’m still a good girl whether that’s how you prefer me or not.
: I don’t have a preference. Futaba being Futaba is all that matters to me. And you were still Futaba even if you were screaming and moaning about wanting Daddy’s cock to-
scene futabanighttraipse5
: Oh, look! A bench! Why don’t we go sit over there?
: Sure. But I have a shift at the tire factory early tomorrow morning, so we’re going to have to make it quick.
scene futabanighttraipse6
: Why did I even say that? I have no idea where it came from.
: Beats me. But hey, you saved me from having to come up with a backstory and I still got to fuck my daughter. So all’s good on my end.
scene black
: Well, hopefully being able to relate to the topic at hand won’t cause you to get as...excited as I did earlier.
: So you really do want to fuck your dad, huh?
scene futabanighttraipse7
: Of course not! But in the context of a fictional setting where I am not Futaba Fukuyama...maybe.
: I’m just teasing you, don’t worry. It doesn’t matter to me who you want to sleep with.
scene futabanighttraipse8
: Well, it should probably matter a little. Because even if you’re seeing other girls, I’d like you to be kind of possessive when it comes to me.
: What right do I have to be possessive of anyone when I get more action from more girls than basically every other male left in Kumon-mi combined?
: None of this is making me feel good about myself, Sensei. I just think it’d be nice to know that the boy I’m interested in isn’t okay with me sleeping around.
: I know. I’m sorry. And I’m not okay with that, for the record. I probably wouldn’t have even said that if I had any sort of real competition in this city.
scene futabanighttraipse9
: That’s a little better...but still.
: I promise I’m just as wholesome now as the day you met me.
: I came inside of you like ten times tonight.
scene futabanighttraipse10
: That just means our baby will be very strong and healthy and there’s nothing to worry about at all.
: Do you mind if I call the tire factory really quick? I need someone to cover for me tomorrow on account of the fact that I’m going to kill myself tonight.
scene futabanighttraipse11
: What's wrong, Sensei? Is two children too many for you?
scene futabanighttraipse12
: What spurred this whole thing with Ami anyway? What was it that made you want to take that final step?
scene futabanighttraipse13
: I wonder how many people I’m going to have to talk to about this.

: Probably most of them. You’ve got a lot of people who really care about you, but you’ve always been a very...specific type of person to all of them. A change this big isn’t something you can just keep hidden.
: It’s not like I want to keep it hidden. I wouldn’t have told you in the first place if that was the case. I just don’t really know what it means when it comes to my relationship with everyone else.
: Like, Ami calling me “Dad” isn’t going to impact what goes on between you and I unless she walks in on us the next time you need to be distracted.
: Let’s avoid that at all costs, shall we?
: Agreed.
: I don’t know, Futaba. There isn’t really one reason I decided that now was the best time for me to step up. It was closer to a million reasons and...recent developments in my personal life.
: Is this about that “person you lost?” The one you told us about in class?
scene futabanighttraipse14
: Losing people is part of life, I think.
: I don’t have any experience with that, of course. My parents are still there, I just can’t contact them at the moment.
: And you’re the first person I’ve ever fallen for, so it’s not like I’ve lost anyone in that regard either.
: But take Nodoka for example. She’s slowly falling out of my life and doesn’t even seem to care at all. And she’s basically always been there, so...that’s a thing I have to just deal with now.
: And while I don’t really know your circumstances, I can say that having to just look at that person I’ve lost feels terrible.
: It makes me angry...regretful...and I feel like an idiot a lot of the time for not seeing it coming.
: But even if I loved her...or love her, despite all that she’s done...I have other people I care about. Just as I’m sure you do.
: So maybe it’s best to just let go. Maybe that old phrase really is accurate after all.
: I think Nodoka’s just stubborn, Futaba.
scene futabanighttraipse15
: I think so too.
: And deep down, I think she really is remorseful about this. But she’ll never come out and say that because that’s not the type of person she is.

: You and her are a lot alike. You dodge subjects that you don’t want to confront or make things up because you think it’s easier than holding yourself accountable. But that doesn’t mean you don’t feel accountable.
: Then...if you know she feels bad, why are you holding it against her? Why not make it easier on her and just bury the hatchet yourself since you’re actually able to?
: Because doing that doesn’t help people grow.
: Nodoka lives in her own world. But that world just happens to be inside of ours. Or...outside. It’s kind of hard to tell with her sometimes.
scene futabanighttraipse16
: And who knows? Maybe I’m wrong and she isn’t actually sorry at all? Maybe I just have a habit of looking for the good in people and...making things up if I can’t find any?
: That’s sort of like what Nodoka and I do then, isn’t it?
: Yes. But I’m not making things up because I want to avoid confrontation. I’m making things up because I’m naive and optimistic.
: You’d really call yourself an optimist?
scene futabanighttraipse17
: Would you?
: About some things, yes.
: This isn’t about some things, though. We’re talking about people who dodge confrontation because of certain things they can’t accept. People who hide things because they’re stubborn and habitual.
: And out of everyone I know...you are the most consistently negative person, Futaba.
: I’m saying this because I care about you.
: You’re saying it because the alternative is that we talk more about you...but you’re right. Maybe I’m doing the same thing.
: I’ve been having a really hard time lately.
: Because of Nodoka?
: No. Not because of Nodoka.
: She certainly isn’t helping, though.
: Then what? What’s going on?
scene futabanighttraipse18
: I’m worried.
: About your parents?
: About never feeling at home.
: In...what way?
: This body.
: This curse.
: Like...what if I’m just never content with the way I look?
: Because I’ve done everything I can think of and nothing’s improved, Sensei. I’m still horrified whenever I have to look at myself.
: I exercise. I eat well. I take supplements. I’ve even started taking therapy sessions online and done tons of research on how high the recovery rates are for people with body dysmorphia.
: It’s like 80%% or something crazy like that. Did you know that? Am I really going to be part of the 20%%? Is this just how I’m going to have to live the rest of my life?
: How am I supposed to do that? I’ve barely begun living.
: Well...how do you expect the rest of us to live with the parts of ourselves that we hate?
: This isn’t just “hating” something, Sensei. I wish it was as simple as that.
: It makes me nauseous...seeing myself. It doesn’t matter if it’s a mirror...a picture...hell, even my shadow repulses me. And losing weight was never going to change that. I get that now.
: And honestly? I kind of wish I had something terminal sometimes. Because at least then I’d know where things are headed.
: Futaba-
: It’s the truth, Sensei.
: Not knowing is what makes all of this so...fucking unbearable. It’s not fair.
: I just want it to end.
: I just want it to be over.
: And so sometimes I imagine what that would be like. Or how I would do it.
: Or what would become of people like Rin or Nodoka or my family or you. And that calms me down a little.
: I love all of you guys. It’s myself that I can’t stomach.
: So please continue to be kind to me, as I am only reluctantly here.
scene futabanighttraipse19
: It’s really that bad?...
: I don’t think anything I can say will ever do justice to how bad it actually is. And I’m well aware that I probably sound really immature for even complaining about this right now.
: Not at all...
: So yeah, that’s where my mind has been lately. Not very fun.
scene futabanighttraipse20
: Yeah, it doesn’t sound like it would be...
: There will always be distractions, I guess. And if that’s just how I have to live the rest of my life so I can avoid confronting reality, whatever.
: You were right to call me out. I have no place to say that you or Nodoka shouldn’t hide in places that make you comfortable when I’d absolutely do the same if I could only find one.
: The closest I’ve got is you — who won’t ever see the same Futaba that I see. And that makes me happy, really.
: I just wish I knew what it was like. I wish I could understand the way other people see me.
: I can relate to you there.
: And I wish I could do more, but it doesn’t seem like I can...
scene futabanighttraipse21
: I don’t think you can, either.
: Ahh...this sucks. We’re together again after so long. I wish I could be happier.
: We could always have sex again.
: Can we? Don’t you have an early shift at the tire factory tomorrow?
scene futabanighttraipse22
: I can call out.
: Not because you’re going to kill yourself, I hope.
: Are you?
: Nah. Rin would get mad.
: So would I.
: But would you disappear for another three months like you did for the last person? Or am I not that important to you?
scene futabanighttraipse23
: Is that...a serious question?
: Of course not, Sensei.
scene black
: I already know the answer.
I take her home and lay her down on the bed.
She does not call me “Daddy” this time — she just locks her eyes on mine and doesn’t look away until I feed her once more.
They lack the life they once had, but I don’t think it’s my fault this time.
I think that sometimes, there are just people who are meant to get lost.
But that’s okay, because...
Huh.
Why is it okay, exactly?
Either way, I leave once Futaba falls asleep.
And while I managed not to get into any of the specifics about why things are the way they are for me now, I found something horrible in the process.
But it’s one of those things you can’t change.
And I don’t know if that makes me feel better or worse.
